title: feat(studio): Data pillar Validations + Settings views (builder-ui Phase B)
body:
Completes the Data pillar v1 surface from the builder-ui pillars plan (Phase B): the two missing views land alongside 记录/表单, both patching the same object draft through the existing save/publish flow.

## Validations view
- No-code editing of `ObjectSchema.validations` **script** rules: name, message, CEL fail-condition (reuses the metadata-admin **ConditionBuilder**, fed the DRAFT field list so unpublished fields are pickable), severity, active, delete.
- Non-script rule types (state_machine / format / …) stay **visible read-only** — the list is a truthful inventory of everything that runs on save; structured configs stay code-authored for now.
- New rules default to a VALID never-firing `condition: 'false'`. Dogfood found that an empty condition 422s the entire draft save (`validations.0.condition: Invalid input`) and dead-ends the create flow — the same required-field-blocks-authoring class as dashboard `layout` / page `regions`.

## Settings view
- Object basics hosted via the shared metadata-admin **default inspector** (one implementation for both surfaces).
- Direct editors for the **ADR-0085 semantic roles**: `nameField`, `stageField` (including the `false` "not a linear flow" state), ordered `highlightFields` chips — the only presentation knobs the protocol carries, now first-class in the builder.

## Rail fix (blocking bug found while verifying)
A freshly-created writable base package hung on "加载中…" forever: `client.list('object')` only sees published metadata, so draft-only packages rendered an eternal spinner. The rail now merges `listDrafts()` headers (dedup by name) and shows an honest empty state.

## Verification
- Browser end-to-end on a live stack: create writable base (ADR-0070 flow) → create draft object → author a validation rule → save draft → reload → full round-trip (also asserted at `/meta/object/:name?state=draft`: rule + `stageField: false` + `highlightFields` all persisted).
- Server guardrails surface correctly in the panel error strip (`writable_package_required` on read-only code packages).
- app-shell: **963 tests green** (5 new for the Validations panel, incl. the valid-default-condition regression).
